searchText: I think at this point any changes to the design are probably not worth it unless they bring pretty huge benefits. I like the general idea of having the TTD be a function of *current* hashrate at well defined points in time, so it can automatically adjust as necessary based on changes in hashrate. However, I doubt it'll pass the bar for critical enough to add this late in the game. Hashrate drop plus bomb means 20-30+ sec blocks which isn’t desirable conditions for the merge How's the attacker profiting from this? Are the mining offline? Or do they just turn their rigs off?
